Summary stats mean_val <- mean(x_vals_non_na) sd_val <- sd(x_vals_non_na) nepal_value <- df |> filter(`Country Name` == "Nepal") |> pull(.data[[v]]) |> first() # Detect whether values are effectively integers is_integerish <- length(x_vals_non_na) > 0 && all(abs(x_vals_non_na - round(x_vals_non_na)) < 1e-8) # Choose histogram settings automatically if (is_integerish && diff(range(x_vals_non_na)) <= 50) { hist_geom <- geom_histogram( binwidth = 1, boundary = -0.5, color = "gray40", fill = "gray80", na.rm = TRUE ) } else { # Freedman-Diaconis rule for continuous variables iqr_val <- IQR(x_vals_non_na) n_val <- length(x_vals_non_na) fd_binwidth <- 2 * iqr_val / (n_val^(1 / 3)) fd_binwidth <- 0.5 * fd_binwidth # Fallback if IQR is zero or binwidth is not usable if (!is.finite(fd_binwidth) || fd_binwidth <= 0) { rng <- diff(range(x_vals_non_na)) fd_binwidth <- if (is.finite(rng) && rng > 0) rng / 30 else 1 } hist_geom <- geom_histogram( binwidth = fd_binwidth, color = "gray40", fill = "gray80", na.rm = TRUE ) } caption_text <- paste0( "Mean = ", scales::number(mean_val, accuracy = 0.01), " | SD = ", scales::number(sd_val, accuracy = 0.01) ) p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[v]])) + hist_geom + annotate( "rect", xmin = mean_val - sd_val, xmax = mean_val + sd_val, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "blue", alpha = 0.12 ) + geom_vline( xintercept = mean_val, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.48 ) + # geom_vline( # xintercept = c(mean_val - sd_val, mean_val + sd_val), # color = "blue", # linetype = "dashed", # linewidth = 0.8 # ) + labs( title = paste("Histogram of", x_lab), x = x_lab, y = "Count", caption = caption_text ) + theme_minimal() + theme( plot.caption = element_text( hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 8) ), plot.caption.position = "plot" ) if (!is.na(nepal_value)) { p <- p + geom_vline( xintercept = nepal_value, color = "red", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8 ) } p } ) walk(plots, print) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](archana_files/figure-html/variable_plots-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](archana_files/figure-html/variable_plots-2.png){width=672} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](archana_files/figure-html/variable_plots-3.png){width=672} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](archana_files/figure-html/variable_plots-4.png){width=672} ::: ::: # the prior is Normal(0, prior_sd); show it out to 3 SDs either side ggplot(draws, aes(x = .data[[param]])) + stat_function( fun = dnorm, args = list(mean = 0, sd = prior_sd), color = "indianred3", linewidth = 1 ) + geom_density( fill = "cornflowerblue", alpha = 0.35, na.rm = TRUE ) + stat_pointinterval( aes(y = 0), point_interval = median_qi ) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3 * prior_sd, 3 * prior_sd)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) + labs( title = param, x = param, y = "Density" ) } ``` ::: # Formal Model $$ \begin{align} WST_i &\sim \text{Normal}(\mu_i,\sigma) \\ \mu_i &= \alpha + \beta_{DWS} DWS_i + \beta_{RUR} RUR_i + \beta_{WSW} WSW_i \\ \alpha &\sim \text{Normal}(50,25) \\ \beta_{DWS} &\sim \text{Normal}(0,10) \\ \beta_{RUR} &\sim \text{Normal}(0,10) \\ \beta_{WSW} &\sim \text{Normal}(0,10) \\ \sigma &\sim \text{Normal}(0,20), \quad \sigma > 0 \end{align} $$ | Variable | Description | Unit | |----------|-------------|------| | $WST_i$ | Water Stress (draw vs availability) | percentage | | $DWS_i$ | Population with Drinking Water Service (%) | standardized | | $RUR_i$ | Rural Population (percent) | standardized | | $WSW_i$ | Government Effectiveness (percentile) | standardized | # Base model Just $WST_i$ ~ $DWS_i$ ::: {.cell output.var='model1_stan'} ```{.stan .cell-code} data { int n; vector[n] WST; vector[n] DWS; } parameters { real alpha; real beta_DWS; real sigma; } transformed parameters { vector[n] mu = alpha + beta_DWS * DWS; } model { alpha ~ normal(<>, <>); beta_DWS ~ normal(0, <>); sigma ~ normal(0, <>); WST ~ normal(mu, sigma); } generated quantities { vector[n] WST_rep; for (i in 1:n) { WST_rep[i] = normal_rng(mu[i], sigma); } } ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} model1 <- knitr::knit_code$get("model1_stan") |> paste(collapse = "\n") |> glue::glue(.open = "<<", .close = ">>") |> write_stan_file(dir = "../.stancache") |> #
